The number seven is significant in the Hebrew tradition, representing completion and release, and is reflected in various time periods and customs, including the seventh year of release for Hebrew slaves and the Jubilee year, which was a time of rest for the land and a new beginning, and these customs are types of the present age, which is characterized by a cycle of seven days, during which sins are forgiven through the philanthropic care of the good Master, so that we are not handed over to punishment for an endless age

pass_b_english: …Having multiplied sevenfold, he set the limit within it. And for seven years the Hebrew was released from slavery. In the past, they made the named Jubilee consisting of seven weeks of years, in which the land rested (Leviticus 25:4), debts were cut off, and there was a release from slavery; and a new life was established from the beginning in the seventh number, in a certain way receiving the completion of the old.

These things are types of this present age, which runs us through by means of the seven days; in which the forgiveness of more moderate sins takes place, according to the philanthropic care of the good Master, so that we are not handed over to punishment for an endless age. The sevenfold, then, is because of the relationship to this world, as if of the beauty-loving men from them…

ἑπτὰ πολυπλασιάσας, ἐν αὐτῷ τὸν ὅρον ἔθετο. Καὶ δι' ἑπτὰ ἐτῶν ὁ Ἑβραῖος ἀπελύετο
τῆς δουλείας. Ἑπτὰ δὲ ἑβδομάδες ἐτῶν τὸ ὀνομαστὸν Ἰωβίλαιον ἐποίουν τοῖς πάλαι,
ἐν ᾧ ἐσαββάτιζεν ἡ γῆ, χρεῶν δὲ ἦσαν ἀποκοπαὶ, καὶ δουλείας ἀπαλλαγὴ, καὶ οἱονεὶ
νέος ἄνωθεν καθίστατο βίος ἐν τῷ ἑβδοματικῷ ἀριθμῷ, τοῦ παλαιοῦ τρόπον τινὰ
τὴν συντέλειαν δεχομένου.
Ταῦτα δὲ τύποι τοῦ αἰῶνος τούτου, ὃς διὰ τῶν ἑπτὰ ἡμερῶν
ἀνακυκλούμενος ἡμᾶς παρατρέχει· ἐν ᾧ γίνονται αἱ τῶν μετριωτέρων ἁμαρτημάτων
